failure_annotations.explanation: Following the initial positioning movement, the robot remains nearly stationary near the oven for approximately seven seconds, with only small positional changes and no visible door opening or renewed acquisition attempt. left_ego_image at frames 52, 80, 100 and 133 shows the unchanged closed door; image and wrist_image show no substantial task-advancing motion over this interval. This is sustained stalling rather than evidence of a particular grasp or hardware failure.
failure_annotations.recovery: Reassess the handle position, align the gripper, establish a secure handle grasp and pull along the door’s opening path while monitoring clearance. No human intervention is visibly required.
